placeholder_contract.{support}: absolute path to the isolated copy of sources/local_gamma_continuations

fresh_copy_rule: For fixed-sibling output jobs, use a disposable full support tree and read the declared fixed output; never run against contributed artifacts.

python-stdlib: Python 3; Fraction and ordinary standard library only

comparison_rule: Within each declared normal/optimized pair, require identical complete mathematical records after deleting only its listed actual optimization field. Retain the actual argv, mode, environment and original/checker/proof/input hashes. Fixed Python version strings remain equal within the same runtime.
scope_notes: Original source17 negative guards execute no regression methods.
New GC,GS,source-cost,GMT,GP mutations execute their complete relevant calculations and reject the declared formula changes.
The delivered floating seed numerical evaluator is archived and inspected; it is not a new certified or declared replay job.
